title: CGC Gate 4.0 Embodied Summary
subtitle: Embodied capability substrate summary and cross-gate FusionRoute projection reference for UI/dashboard consumption

headline.summary: Gate 4.0 remains the validated embodied capability substrate. In the FusionRoute final topology draft, Gate 4.0 is consumed by Gate 5.0 UI-TARS as the embodied capability plane rather than the primary agent runtime.

capability_cards.title: FusionRoute topology projection reference
capability_cards.summary: Gate 4.0 truth source now references the independent FusionRoute topology matrix and the Gate 6.0 role locality draft without changing current validated counters.

formally_claimable: Gate 4.0 remains the embodied capability substrate with unified embodied CLI, edge-cloud fusion, Self-Harness inheritance, and robot/device interfaces.
Gate 4.0 truth source formally references the independent FusionRoute topology matrix and Gate 6.0 role locality draft as architecture projections.
not_yet_formally_claimable: The new cross-gate topology matrix is an architecture projection and does not itself prove runtime closure.
Gate 6.0 role locality / placement has not yet been promoted to a formally validated capability in the current repo snapshot.

fusionroute_topology_matrix.projection_role: Gate 4.0 is the Embodied Capability Plane callable by Gate 5.0 UI-TARS.

fusionroute_role_locality.projection_role: Role locality / placement stays under Gate 6.0 and may target Gate 4.0 endpoints.

validation_snapshot.summary: Gate 4.0 summary/checkin/gate_map skeleton is now available and references the new cross-gate FusionRoute topology artifacts.
